input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
input.rationale: Section 6.1 imposes exclusive dealing on the Company: for the entire term it may not participate in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products or substantially similar products, and HDI additionally takes the exclusive right to use the Company's own "Deerskin" brand for a direct-to-consumer web site. The term runs one year and renews automatically on each anniversary (Section 4.1), so the restriction is open-ended, and there is no automatic performance-based exit — Section 1.6 gives only a discretionary termination right if the Site is not live in 70 days, which does not end exclusivity automatically on service-level or delivery-date failure. The only carve-out (Section 6.2, closeout merchandise) does not narrow the covenant to a 12-month, exit-linked exclusivity. That is walk-away territory (exclusive dealing for the full term with no performance-based exit), so it fails the fallback. We therefore take the preferred position and replace the covenant with a no-exclusivity statement, which also removes HDI's exclusive hold on our own brand; HDI's reciprocal restriction in Section 6.3 benefits us and is left in place.

ops.oldText: Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
ops.newText: The Company shall have no exclusivity, non-compete or sole-supplier obligation under this Agreement, and HDI shall have no exclusive right to use the "Deerskin" brand.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6.1 barred the Company for the whole (annually renewing) term from any similar Internet project for Deerskin or comparable products and handed HDI the exclusive right to our own "Deerskin" brand online, with no performance-based exit, so we have replaced it with a statement that the Company carries no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation. If HDI needs protection, our fallback is exclusivity confined to a defined product category, capped at 12 months and ending automatically on any HDI service-level or delivery-date failure. HDI's reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 and our retained closeout rights in Section 6.2 are untouched.
proposal.summary: Replace the Company-side exclusivity covenant and HDI's exclusive Deerskin brand right in Section 6.1 with a no-exclusivity statement.

mappings.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
